summary: The comment urges preservation of E-Rate services and funding, emphasizing the critical role of libraries and schools in providing connectivity for community needs.

claims.argument: Preserving E-Rate ensures essential broadband services remain available
claims.evidence_quote: I respectfully urge the FCC to preserve the core services of E-Rate, including support for affordable broadband, Internet access, internal connections, public Wi-Fi, maintenance, and cost-effective network solutions.
